title: Should freight brokers buy shipper lists?
seoTitle: Should freight brokers buy shipper lists?
searchIntent: Why does Luis advise against buying generic shipper lists?
excerpt: Why a purchased list can leave you with crowded prospects, stale contacts and little understanding of the companies you call.
takeaway: A shipper list is only a set of leads, not a book of customers. Build the ability to research and qualify companies yourself, and verify any purchased data before spending time on outreach.

sections.title: Why does Luis advise against buying generic shipper lists?
paragraphs: Luis raises three concerns: the same contacts may be sold repeatedly, the information may be out of date and the shortcut does little to develop your prospecting ability. A large spreadsheet can look like progress while leaving the hard work untouched.

The issue is not the number of rows. It is whether you understand the company, can reach the right person and have a credible reason to offer your service. Those things still need to be established after a list arrives.

sections.title: Shared contacts do not give you a distinct approach
paragraphs: If many brokers receive the same list and use the same generic opening, the prospect has little reason to distinguish one from another. The list does not supply knowledge of the company or a useful answer to its transportation problems.
Build context around each prospect. Learn the product, locations and likely shipping needs, then confirm them in conversation. That preparation is what makes the contact useful.

sections.title: Verify the data before relying on it
paragraphs: People change roles, businesses change ownership and transportation decisions move between departments. Check the company’s current information and confirm the contact’s responsibilities. A recognizable name is not proof that the record is accurate.

If you evaluate a data provider, ask about source, update practices and permitted use. Do not assume a seller’s promise makes every record current or appropriate for your outreach. Luis’s criticism is a warning to evaluate the value, not evidence that every data service is fraudulent.

sections.title: Build a prospecting skill you can repeat
paragraphs: Choose a manageable group of companies and research them properly. Record what each ships, who appears responsible and what you still need to ask. Refine the list using the conversations you have.

That process takes effort, but it gives you a method you can use again. The goal is to understand how to find relevant businesses whenever the pipeline needs attention, instead of repeatedly buying a new list and hoping it contains an easy customer.
